question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher asked the students to stay _______ during the exam.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quiet**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**quiet**" means making little or no noise. (शांत)
 
• In the context of an exam, students are expected to be silent or quiet to maintain a proper environment.
 
• The other options: "**quite**," "**quote**," and "**quit**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The teacher asked the students to stay quiet__ during the exam.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Quite (काफी)**: means to a certain or significant extent.
 
• **Quote (उद्धरण)**: means to repeat or copy out a group of words from a text or speech.
 
• **Quit (छोड़ देना)**: means to leave or stop doing something.
